rationale_one_line: RuView reads rooms through walls with no camera, so the surveillance-room cctv pack is the literal aesthetic, and RECEIPT lets the numbers (0 cameras, sub-200ms, 6 channels) carry the proof.
writing_tone_notes: Cool, observational, declarative. Surveillance-room calm. Let the numbers land hard and quiet. Contractions where natural. No superlatives; the no-camera contrast carries the praise.
do_rules: Lead the video with concrete numbers, not adjectives.
Keep the star count for the X caption only; scenes use other numbers.
Stay in the surveillance/sensing metaphor: signal, room, walls, presence.
At least one orbit move; flash beat in accent red for the stop-scroll.
dont_rules: No version numbers in the X caption.
Do not reuse the phrase 'through walls' in the caption (it is a scene flash word).
No creepy framing; the honest story is privacy without a lens.
No framework repeat of SCHEMATIC (most recent on 2026-05-29).
